board: Luxorparts DS04-NFC 360° continuous rotation servo (Kjell & Company 90770), 3-wire JR/Futaba lead
reason: Modelled from the Luxorparts/Kjell DS04-NFC datasheet: 1.0-2.0 ms at 50 Hz, stop at 1.5 ms, CCW below 1.5 ms and CW above, 4.8-6 V supply on V+ with up to 1000 mA. The check passed on ESP32 and Pico (cw/ccw/stop sim test, clean DRC, footprint). The dead band is not in the datasheet, so the model assumes a narrow 20 us band.
breakoutPinoutSource: Luxorparts DS04-NFC datasheet connector drawing: A Black (-), B Red (+), C White (signal), 2.54 mm pitch (https://www.kjell.com/globalassets/mediaassets/701903_90770_datasheet_en.pdf)
